variants.name: RopeRailing
variants.collider: 2 boxes for the posts + 1 thin box (or capsule) along the rope at 0.55-0.8 m; rope collider blocks walking off the edge
variants.joins: post A centre x=-1.329, post B centre x=1.301 (pivot = bounds centre); neighbouring sections overlap one post or leave ~0.1 m; corners by rotating a section
variants.notes: Modelled: posts with carved notches, 6 rope wraps, sagging rope, knot (2 loops) with tails, frayed fibres, iron staples, iron foot band, nailed patch, loose/bent nails, splinters at split tops, 4 foot wedges, broken board on the ground, earth heaped at the feet, clods/pebbles/chips/shavings/needles/leaves. Rope = Props `rope`, post tops end_grain.
